events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A limited-time CHANEL fragrance experience built around COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU, with personalized fragrance discovery, the wider COCO MADEMOISELLE line, hair and body products, makeup, and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Public entry and the fragrance experience are free. Products are available to purchase onsite.
events.caveats: CHANEL says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. A current NYC event source explicitly describes the event as free and open to the public.
events.practical_notes: Appointments are recommended, not required. Use CHANEL's official event page to check appointment availability, or walk in during the listed hours.

events.what_it_is: An immersive Good Girl fragrance pop-up celebrating the scent's 10th anniversary, with fragrance discovery, interactive challenges, beauty activities and the Good Girl Café.
events.what_is_free: Timed tickets are free. Walk-ins are also allowed based on capacity. Interactive challenges can yield prizes such as miniatures and makeup services; the first 100 guests can receive Carolina Herrera x Myka frozen yogurt.
events.caveats: Walk-ins are capacity-dependent. Prize inventory and the frozen-yogurt offer are limited; the first-100 frozen-yogurt offer can end early.
events.practical_notes: Use the free Eventbrite timed-ticket page if you want a reservation. Current event listings explicitly state walk-ins are allowed based on capacity, so this is not approval-required access.
